method.acceptance: each sample times ONE run_start call to its 202 accept response on a fresh §9 request key; the advisory run-check preflight and the poll to terminal (which frees the bench's one live-run slot) sit OUTSIDE every timed window — PRD §6 excludes device execution. Sequential on the single admitted bench: the committed fixture lattice admits exactly one bench per gateway and §5 holds one live run per bench, so a second concurrent run_start CONFLICTS at accept rather than measuring — the declared two-observer posture is recorded as observers_declared, the achieved shape as observers
method.percentile: linear interpolation, rank = q * (n - 1), over the sorted sample
method.reads: 100 metadata reads (GET /v1/benches, GET /v1/runs/{id}, GET /v1/benches/{id}/events, rotating) by 2 concurrent observer threads while one run is live; a background driver restarts seeded runs as each reaches terminal and the achieved live fraction is reported as active_run_coverage (accept-response to terminal observation, 0.2 s poll granularity)
method.stress: 16 observers x 100 metadata reads each (the same rotating read set), barrier-started so the whole burst is simultaneous, while the active-run driver keeps a run live; NON-REFERENCE and NON-GATING — it exists to make the D13 async-single-loop (blocking SQLite on one event loop) disclosure honest, not to gate anything
method.timer: time.perf_counter around each GatewayClient call (stdlib only)
